# foreman_setting (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_setting" "append_domain_name_for_hosts" {
  name = "append_domain_name_for_hosts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `name` (String) The name of the setting to look up.
